name: register-tab

frames.best_why: The sign-in panel is fully drawn: logo tile, heading, three social buttons, two fields and a white submit, all settled.

tagline: A dark sign-in card with social buttons and a Login/Register switch on top.
summary: A centred dark auth card with a small two-pill mode switch above it. Login offers Google, Apple and Facebook buttons, email and password fields and a white submit; Register adds a username and phone number.
appearance: A tall rounded near-black card on a black stage, topped by a pale rounded logo tile, a bold Welcome Back heading and a muted line under it. Three bordered social buttons run across, then an OR rule, two dark input fields and a white Sign in button.
behaviour: Pressing Login or Register swaps the panel below the switch: the old card fades out while the new one fades in, so both are briefly visible. Social buttons lighten on hover, and the fields lose any focus outline.
demo_content: Welcome Back and Register Account headings, with Google, Apple and Facebook sign-in buttons.
search_phrases: dark sign in form with social login
email password form with google button
create account panel with phone field
centered auth card for an app
toggle between sign in and sign up
signup form with apple and facebook
small logo above a login box
use_when: A small product needs a self-contained sign-in panel with social options and a register mode.
avoid_when: The form is a shell: no submit handler, validation or state, and every field and colour is hard-coded.
customise: No props: headings, placeholder text, panel copy and social icons are written in the file, and the widths and colours are hard-coded classes.
weight_why: One card, a few inputs and inline icon graphics; only the panel switch animates.

a11y.note: Fields rely on placeholders instead of labels, the icon-only social buttons have no name, and focus outlines are removed.

issues: Frames 2 and 5 catch both panels mid-fade, so two headings and two forms overlap.
Icon-only social buttons carry no accessible name and fields have no labels.
The white Sign in button has no hover state, unlike the social buttons.
polish_why: Tidy dark card with clear modes; the cross-fade doubles the forms and controls look stock.
